snapshot.name: queue_sessions
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, state, revision::text AS revision, queue_revision::text AS queue_revision, minimum_games, updated_at FROM queue_sessions ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_players
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, club_player_id, player_id_at_entry, name_snapshot, present, present_changed_at, (SELECT a.source_operation_id FROM club_assessments a WHERE a.id = session_players.assessment_id) AS assessment_operation_id, skill_level_id, level_locked_at, confirmed_at, joined_at, over_budget_at, released_at, release_reason, no_show_at, games_adjustment, revision::text AS revision, created_at, updated_at FROM session_players ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: club_assessments
snapshot.sql: SELECT club_player_id, session_id, session_player_id, player_id_at_assessment, skill_level_id, (SELECT s.source_operation_id FROM club_assessments s WHERE s.id = club_assessments.supersedes_id) AS supersedes_operation_id, source_operation_id, assessed_at, received_at, accepted_revision::text AS accepted_revision, actor_club_id FROM club_assessments ORDER BY source_operation_id

snapshot.name: session_waitlist
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, club_player_id, skill_level_id, added_at, demoted_at, demoted_confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_waitlist ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_join_requests
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, name, nickname, phone_e164, status, placement, requested_at, decided_at, decided_by_device_id, club_player_id, player_id, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_join_requests ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: club_players
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, player_id, (SELECT e.rtr_id FROM shared_player_entries e WHERE e.id = club_players.shared_entry_id) AS shared_entry_rtr_id, display_name, nickname, added_at, removed_at, linked_to_club_player_id, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM club_players ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: club_player_private_inputs
snapshot.sql: SELECT club_player_id, club_id, phone_e164, email, state, captured_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM club_player_private_inputs ORDER BY club_player_id

snapshot.name: shared_player_entries
snapshot.sql: SELECT email, rtr_id, creating_club_id, country_code, city_code, sync_date, sequence, allocated_at, claimed_player_id, retired_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM shared_player_entries ORDER BY rtr_id

snapshot.name: player_id_counters
snapshot.sql: SELECT l.country_code, l.city_code, c.sync_date, c.last_sequence FROM player_id_counters c JOIN location_codes l ON l.id = c.location_code_id ORDER BY l.city_code, c.sync_date

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT n.player_id, n.kind, n.title, n.body, n.target, n.source_type, COALESCE((SELECT a.source_operation_id FROM club_assessments a WHERE n.source_type = 'club_assessment' AND a.id = n.source_id), n.source_id) AS source_id, n.created_at, n.read_at FROM player_notifications n ORDER BY n.player_id, n.kind, n.source_type, 7

snapshot.name: session_match_requests
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, session_player_id, status, decided_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_match_requests ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: admin_audit_events
snapshot.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM admin_audit_events
